model.description: A group of member addresses referenced by { group } principals in the auth scope. Group membership is folded at an operation's position during auth evaluation, so reducers are strict and deterministic: duplicate or unknown members are errors, and membership is capped.
model.name: Reactor Group

modules.description: Manage the group's identity and its member address list.
modules.name: Group

operations.description: Set the display name of the group. The name must be non-empty after trimming and at most 200 characters.

errors.description: The group name is empty after trimming or longer than 200 characters.
errors.name: InvalidGroupName

operations.name: SetGroupName

operations.description: Set the free-text description of the group. The description is at most 2000 characters.

errors.description: The group description is longer than 2000 characters.
errors.name: InvalidGroupDescription

operations.name: SetGroupDescription

operations.description: Add a member address to the group. The address must be non-empty after trimming, must not already be a member under case-insensitive comparison, and the group must be below the member cap.

errors.description: The member address is empty after trimming.
errors.name: InvalidMemberAddress

errors.description: The address is already a member of the group under case-insensitive comparison.
errors.name: DuplicateMember

errors.description: The group already holds the maximum number of members.
errors.name: GroupMemberLimitExceeded

operations.name: AddMember

operations.description: Remove a member address from the group, matched case-insensitively. Removing an address that is not a member is an error.

errors.description: The address is not a member of the group under case-insensitive comparison.
errors.name: MemberNotFound

operations.name: RemoveMember

materialized.schema:
"""
A member address list gated by the group document's own auth scope. Addresses
are stored as given and compared case-insensitively, matching how { address }
principals are compared during auth evaluation.
"""
type ReactorGroupState {
  "Display name of the group."
  name: String!
  "Free-text description of the group's purpose."
  description: String!
  "Member wallet addresses. No duplicates under case-insensitive comparison."
  members: [String!]!
}

fields.description: Free-text description of the group's purpose.
fields.name: description

fields.description: Member wallet addresses. No duplicates under case-insensitive comparison.
fields.name: members

types.name: ReactorGroupState
